description: OpenModelica Microgrid Gym connects Modelica microgrid models with Python controller experiments through a Gym-style environment. It supports reinforcement learning and conventional control for power-electronic converters. The provider is upb-lea (repository owner). Coverage: The toolbox represents user-configured microgrids. Network detail, simulation step and experiment duration depend on the supplied models. Access: The provider publishes a metadata page describing the resource and its access route. Resource files were not downloaded or executed. Licence and cost: The README identifies GNU GPL version 3 and free software. Dependency licensing remains separate. Limitations: The README officially supports Windows and Linux and recommends a Linux virtual machine for macOS. PyFMI and OpenModelica compatibility was not tested; external reuse and current maintenance were not established. For simulation it supports controlled comparisons of microgrid control policies. Related resources: No existing catalogue record explicitly covers this microgrid Gym environment.
